collection.title: Vauxhall Monaro 2004 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Monaro 2004 - 2007 requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
